data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 were $58.696m (gross). During 2021 gross claims outstanding increased materially to $139.365m at year end, reflecting growth of the syndicate and heightened claims activity. The report attributes difficult claims conditions and adverse claims experience to natural catastrophe events (notably Hurricanes Ida, Laura and Storm Uri) and notes geopolitical uncertainty following the invasion of Ukraine; the syndicate also highlights IBNR as a critical estimate. The report does not disclose a single, explicit gross prioryear (pre-2021) movement figure in the notes, so a definitive gross prioryear development amount (2019 & earlier) is not stated in the available gross movement notes.
raw_causal_phrases: despite having already been impacted by adverse claims experience as a result of Hurricanes Ida, Laura and Storm Uri.

The 2021 underwriting year has experienced strong premium growth and the syndicate continued to see reductions in expenses as it grew, delivering an expense ratio of 24% in 2021, demonstrating the success of its low-cost tracker model.
The recent tragic invasion of Ukraine which has sparked war in Eastern Europe is an ongoing reminder of the complexities the syndicate faces when navigating risk.

The most critical estimate included within the syndicate's financial position is the estimate for losses incurred but not reported ('IBNR'), which is included within total technical provisions and reinsurers' share of technical provisions in the balance sheet and note 10.
The total estimate as at 31 December 2021 included within claims outstanding on the balance sheet is $114,783.4k (2020: $50,871.8k).
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year (pre-2021) movement figure (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding shown as a separate gross column) was found in the notes. The technical provisions reconciliation shows total change in gross claims provision for 2021 but that includes current-year movement and cannot be used per the rules. A claims development table exists but is presented primarily as lossratio percentages and a per-year gross outstanding summary; there are insufficient prior-diagonal numeric rows printed to compute a robust gross prioryear development by the triangle method for 2019 & earlier. The 2019 year closed by reinsurance to close which may distort comparisons. All amounts reported are in the syndicate's functional currency (USD) and have been converted from $'000 to millions. prior_year_development_gbp_m therefore set to null.
